notes.notes:

[list]
[*] The currency changes will be reflected on the screen.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The NPCs fixed the collisions on the road.

notes.title: 0.2.1 Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]You can buy a phone from the E-buy website.
[*]The number of customers selling phones has been increased.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The bug causing phones to get lost during phone repairs has been fixed.
[*]Prices have been corrected
[*]The time spent on phone repairs has been reduced.
[*]The bug causing some doors not to open has been fixed.
[*]The bug causing the NPCs to multiply without reason while roaming the road has been fixed.
[/list]

[i]Note: If you are experiencing a game-breaking bug related to this update, please reopen the game with 'New Game'.[/i]

notes.title: 0.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players!

It is with great excitement that we announce a new update for Mobile Store Simulator! Our team has worked hard to make your gaming experience even richer and bring you even more fun. Here's what's new:

1. New Characters:
There are new characters added to our game, we have removed the old ones, we have added brand new characters

2. Brand New Maps:
Get ready to explore because with 0.2.0, enjoy the new map added to our game.

3. Enhanced Graphics:
We have added new graphics that will improve the quality of the game.

4. Bug Fixes and Improvements:
Taking feedback from the community into account, we've fixed in-game bugs and made several improvements to improve overall performance.

With this update, we look forward to bringing you a gaming experience like you've never experienced before. Don't miss this exciting update full of new features and content!

Don't forget to check the update and share with us on social media. We can't wait to share this journey with you!

Have a great game!

Best regards,
Flugames team

notes.title: Closed Beta Test Results and Exciting Developments!
notes.notes:
Dear Players

We have successfully completed the closed beta testing of our upcoming game, and with the positive feedback received, we made significant improvements and changes to provide you with a higher-quality gaming experience. Throughout this process, we have essentially rebuilt the game, changing the city and enhancing overall quality.

We appreciate your understanding and patience during the delays in updates. Currently, we are in the final stages of completion and preparing to launch the full version of the game.

We are grateful for the interest you have shown, and we will continue to keep you informed about the full release of the game. If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime.

Thank you,
Flugames Team

notes.title: New Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
📱 Hello Mobile Game Enthusiasts! A Whole New World Awaits You! 🌟

The time you've been waiting for is finally here! We proudly present the dazzling new version of our game, "Mobile Store Simulator"! Get ready to dive into the mobile world as we bring you the most realistic store simulation.

🛍️ Manage, Expand, and Customize Your Store!

Now you have the opportunity to manage your own mobile store. Purchase the products you desire, adorn your storefront, and take your store to the top by providing the best service to customers. More customers mean more profit!

🚀 Discover Innovative Features and Graphics!

With our latest version, we've enhanced the graphics and introduced innovative features to enrich your gaming experience. Realistic animations, detailed store designs, and much more await you.

🙏 Thanks for YOUR Interest!

We are grateful for the interest and support you've shown for our game. Sharing this adventure with you gives us endless motivation and energy.

📅 Brand New Version Coming Soon! 🌟

We are thrilled to announce: the new version of Mobile store simulator is just around the corner! As preparations are in full swing, we can't wait to share with you an experience filled with surprises and innovations.

Stay tuned because surprises are waiting for you! 📲✨

notes.title: Mobile Store Simulator Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44659923/90843fc3738f993e1bc1ea5e57321891291fb53b.png[/img]Hey Mobile Store Simulator Enthusiasts! 📱🎮

We are thrilled to announce that the DEMO version of "Mobile Store Simulator" is now available! Take charge of the mobile technology world and seize the opportunity to manage your dream mobile store.

Game Features:

Extensive Product Range: Manage your game with a wide range of products, from the latest smartphones to tablet computers.
Store Design: Customize your own store and make adjustments to provide the best customer experience.
Customer Relations: Increase customer satisfaction and use various strategies to gain loyal customers.
Competition: Compete against other players and develop strategies to create the best mobile store.
Training Mode: Start with a training mode for beginners and become an expert.
Why Should You Play "Mobile Store Simulator"?

Offers a fun and educational experience for anyone interested in mobile technology.
Test your ability to manage your own store and improve your business skills.
Explore the inner workings of the mobile world and gain knowledge about new devices.
Download the Demo Version and Dive into the Mobile World:

Download the "Mobile Store Simulator" DEMO version now and start experiencing the excitement of the mobile technology world! Don't miss this limited version of the game, and be sure to share your feedback with us. We can't wait for the full version!

Note: The DEMO version is offered as a preview of the full version and has limited content.
